title: Joint extreme values of $L$-functions on and off the critical line
summary: It is shown that any number of distinct primitive $\mathrm{GL}(1)$ and $\mathrm{GL}(2)$ $L$-functions can simultaneously attain large values on the critical line. This is an unconditional improvement of a general result due to Heap and Li who have assumed the Riemann Hypothesis for more than three such $L$-functions. The joint distribution of $\mathrm{GL}(m)$ $L$-functions to the right of the critical line is also studied under certain zero-density estimates.
